Project

Risk of Simply Standing Still

Interactive companion to the poster of the same name — a citywide transit & urban-heat study, focused on bus unreliability and subway inaccessibility.

Geography & transit

Neighborhoods — NYC Dept. of City Planning, 2020 NTAs.

Subway lines — MTA GTFS static feed. Stations & bus stops — MTA / NYC Open Data, citywide.

Surface temperature

Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface-temperature band (USGS/NASA), via Microsoft Planetary Computer — real 30m satellite thermal data, not modeled.

One lowest-cloud summer scene per year (2005/2010/2015/2020/2025), zonal-averaged per neighborhood.

Basemap & build

Vector tiles — OpenFreeMap · © CARTO. MapLibre GL, D3.js (contrast charts, bus-delay waffle grid, wait/temp scatter).

Palette after "Vulnerable Neighbourhoods in the Netherlands." Built with AI assistance.

Real, measured data: neighborhood/station/line/bus-stop geometry, satellite surface temperature (Landsat), bus on-time performance (MTA Bus Wait Assessment, 388 real routes), and subway ridership (sampled). Bus delay is shown per route (not per stop — NYC has no open per-stop schedule feed) in the Wait & Heat Districts panel, kept off the map so it doesn't compete with the surface-temperature layer. Subway line thickness reflects a 2024 ridership sample, not a continuous series.
